tokens.name: felt
tokens.usage: The table itself: the stage in the middle of the screen. Paper text reads 7.5:1 on it. Muted text does NOT (3.0:1) — keep secondary text off felt.

tokens.name: felt-dark
tokens.usage: Page background, seat pods, lobby seats, dialogs. Paper 13:1, muted 5.0:1, accent 6.9:1.

tokens.name: felt-deep
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Trays that hold your own stuff: the action dock and your hand. One step darker than felt-dark so 'mine' reads as a separate surface. Muted 6.3:1, accent 8.6:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Hairlines, idle ring tracks, outlines of secondary buttons on felt-dark / felt-deep. Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary text on every felt surface; label strips on animal cards; focus ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper, accent and animal colours. Also the 3.5px outline every piece of art uses.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Secondary text on paper (animal value under the name). 6.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and hints on felt-dark and felt-deep only (5.0:1 / 6.3:1). Fails on felt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Means 'you, now': your-turn ring, primary button, selected money notes, top bid number. Ink text on it. As text on felt only at 19px bold or larger (4.4:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Excluded bidder, offline, last 5 seconds of a countdown, Close room. Fill only, with paper text in bold (4.4:1 — source pair, just under 4.5).

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Connected dot in the lobby. Always paired with the word or a name, never alone.

tokens.name: set-gold
tokens.usage: Completed set of four: the ring around an animal chip or tile. Converted from the named colour 'gold' in styles.css.

tokens.name: animal-rooster
tokens.usage: Rooster (10). Card background behind the art; ink count on a paper badge, never ink text straight on it.

tokens.name: animal-goose
tokens.usage: Goose (40).

tokens.name: animal-cat
tokens.usage: Cat (90). Dark: the name must sit on the paper strip, not on this colour.

tokens.name: animal-dog
tokens.usage: Dog (160). Dark: name on the paper strip.

tokens.name: animal-sheep
tokens.usage: Sheep (250). Close to paper — its card needs the ink outline to read.

tokens.name: animal-goat
tokens.usage: Goat (350).

tokens.name: animal-donkey
tokens.usage: Donkey (500). Dark: name on the paper strip.

tokens.name: animal-horse
tokens.usage: Horse (1000). Near accent — horse cards always carry art and the ink outline so they never read as a button.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one number that matters right now: top bid, the amount in the bid stepper, who goes first. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else; the base size of the table at a 390px-tall screen.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Player names in seat pods and bidder pills. Ellipsis at 8em.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase captions over numbers: TOP BID, DECK, NEXT DONKEY. Muted on felt-dark/felt-deep, paper at 80% on felt.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Counts on tiles and pills. Ink on paper badges only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a pill, tile-to-count.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Grid gap between table regions; gap between pods.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside pods, dock and hand; gap between dock buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; stage inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Overlay padding; side gutter in lobby and forms.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Animal tiles, money notes (the art has its own 8/160 corner).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the bid stepper.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Seat pods, dock, hand tray, lot card.

tokens.name: radius-table
tokens.usage: The felt stage — the one soft, table-like shape on screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, bidder pills, countdown ring.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Flat offset under buttons and cards — matches the bold-outline art, no blur.

tokens.name: lift-lg
tokens.usage: The lot card and lifted (selected) money notes.

meta.note: Existing values copied from styles.css and ANIMAL_COLOR. Tokens marked PROPOSED are new and belong to the table redesign.
